headline: Seasons of Celebration planning, including foyer decorating on November 30 and takedown on January 4.
summary: A financial update and a review of Halloween are also on the agenda. Seasons of Celebration planning sets the dates to decorate the front foyer and take the decorations down.
items: Seasons of Celebration planning: decorate front foyer on November 30, 2026 at 8:30 a.m.
Take down decorations on January 4, 2027 at 8:30 a.m.
